message: きっと、その頃は……
On my way to the old school building, I caught sight of Misasagi-senpai. Unusually for someone normally so composed, she was heading somewhere at a brisk pace.

name: Paqy
message: 「Black tights are totally old-ladyish」

name: Synn
message: 「You have way too foul a mouth. You're supposed to say Misasagi-senpai is mature」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah, man, she was holdin' two walnuts in one hand. Still in the shell, too」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, old folks do often roll them around in their hands like that, don't they」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh…… Even Master Synn thinks so, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「This isn't the time for leading questions. Let's follow after Senpai!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why the heck for?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because isn't that amazing! I wonder if there's a walnut tree growing on the academy grounds? Let's go gather some too!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You sound like a penny-pinchin' housewife……」

name: Synn
message: 「Walnuts make great preserved food!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright, alright, don't get all worked up explainin' it」
H-Huh? We ended up at the Kujo family mansion.
I hadn't given any prior notice of a visit. Peeking quietly from the shadow of the gatepost, I saw Misasagi-senpai and Ria-senpai deep in conversation near the parking area.
Could the two of them be making plans to go gather walnuts together?

name: Paqy
message: 「Give it a rest with the food already, will ya?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ayaka-chan, come on inside. I'll brew some tea!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Much obliged. Don't trouble yourself, though. It's nothin' important anyway」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ria, would you mind takin' these?」

name: Ria
message: 「Sure, what are they……?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Two almond seeds, they are」

name: Ria
message: 「Whoa! Those are rare」

name: Paqy
message: 「Z-Zzz, zzz」
Perhaps embarrassed at having mistaken almond seeds for walnuts, Paqy starts blatantly faking sleep.

name: Misasagi
message: 「If you don't mind, go ahead and plant 'em in a corner of the Kujo estate's garden or somethin'」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm, then maybe next to the fir tree would be good. Should I bury the two seeds side by side?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Yes, it might be best not to space them too far apart. You need two trees for almonds to bear fruit, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ooh~ I've never seen an almond tree before.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「They're rather unremarkable trees... though their blossoms are quite lovely.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Blooming later than peach trees, yet earlier than cherry blossoms... there is nothing quite so wonderful for enjoying flower-viewing without worrying about crowds.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ayanishiki-chan...」

name: Ria
message: 「When that time comes, let's have a flower-viewing party together♪」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Yes, I would love to come.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「...Though at the very earliest, it takes five years after sprouting before the flowers bloom.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my, that's a long time.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「--Where the ancient almond tree dwells as if it belongs there,」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Along that dear, nostalgic starry path--」

name: Ria
message: 「Along the starry path, into the distance.」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, Ayanishiki-chan... you shouldn't go imitating Goethe like that\s07」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, I should have expected no less. You caught me.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe, I wonder what kind of poem will come to mind when I see the almond blossoms with my own eyes? I can't wait.」

name: Ria
message: 「So, Ayanishiki-chan, how deep should I bury the seeds?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ahh~~ Apparently, you have to soak the seeds in water overnight to soften the shells first.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s02 You don't actually know, do you, Ayanishiki-chan?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「F-Forgive me...」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah, let's go inside the house after all, okay? Big Sis has tons of books, so we can definitely look up how to grow almonds too!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, I shall gladly accept your invitation.」
Misasagi-senpai and Ria-senpai head toward the mansion's entrance. I step away from the front of the gate.

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan really cares about her friends, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misasagi-senpai is the same. Having someone you can make a promise with for five years from now--I'm jealous.」
As I walk along the path toward the Student Council room once more, I'm reminded again of the heavy responsibility of the Crusaders.
If we don't stop Re-Crea, there won't be a world five years from now...
